WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, e."aCL IgM" AS igm
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(igm) AS mean_igm
  FROM joined
),
centered AS (
  SELECT j.patient_id, j.sex, j.igm, j.igm - o.mean_igm AS deviation
  FROM joined AS j
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
),
sex_means AS (
  SELECT sex, AVG(deviation) AS mean_deviation
  FROM centered
  GROUP BY sex
)
SELECT c.patient_id, c.sex, c.igm, c.deviation, c.deviation - s.mean_deviation
FROM centered AS c
JOIN sex_means AS s ON c.sex = s.sex
WHERE c.deviation > s.mean_deviation
ORDER BY c.deviation - s.mean_deviation DESC
LIMIT 10
